benefits.text:
hince Half-Moon Cheek is a cream-to-powder blush with a unique creamy blur texture that applies to the skin like a cream but sets smooth like a powder. It creates a soft flushed-cheek effect, helps the cheek surface look smoother, helps blur the look of pores and texture, and gives a clear, silky-smooth and refined layer of color. The color blends easily and can be layered to adjust intensity without making the makeup look thick or heavy, suitable for everyday makeup in a soft, subtle glow style.

The limited edition from the 2026 Chill Voyage Collection includes 2 new shades in the spirit of sun-kissed neutral baked colors: 08 Dolce and 09 Bubble. Shade 08 Dolce is a warm peach baked tone, like a light touch of summer sun on the skin, suited to warm, sandy rose or peach nude makeup, or layouts that need a lightly warm cheek color that still looks clean and refined. Shade 09 Bubble is a soft milky baked lavender, gently cool and clear, suited to cool-tone makeup, a clean blue look, or layouts that need a fresh, light milky lavender cheek color that stands apart from basic peach pink. Both shades keep the soft blurred flush effect, are easy to layer and help the face look fresher, in the summer mood of the Chill Voyage collection.

safety.text:
For external use on the cheeks only; avoid use on scratched or irritated skin
Discontinue use if any unusual signs appear, and keep out of reach of children.

texture.text: Creamy blur, soft and smooth, melts with body heat, sets like a powder.

howToUse.text: Take an appropriate amount with your fingertip and gently roll/blend it onto the cheeks so the formula melts with body heat and melds into the skin. You can build up thin layers one at a time to increase color intensity as desired.

positioning.text: Cream-to-powder blush that helps create a smooth, lightly blurred and natural flush, as if dusted with a sheer layer of powder.

sellingPoints.text: Unique cream-to-powder texture; helps blur the look of pores and the skin's surface; fresh, vivid color that can be layered without turning dull.

finish.text: Velvety blur / clear finish / soft matte glow.

claimDisclaimers.text: The 24-hour color lasting test claim is recorded in the file as a test result for signature shade #04 Ribbon; do not interpret it as absolute color wear for all shades/all conditions. The 88% pore coverage improvement claim must be used within the brand's test context; do not say it replaces skincare products.
